title: DataLogger via HDC - bn716
description: DataLogger tags delivered by the extractor to the Helin Data Collector and written by its Timescale north plugin (flatmap: "timestamp", asset, datapoint, value TEXT). A tag name is rebuilt from asset + datapoint, so --asset-mode signal (asset = tag, datapoint = value), --asset-mode group (asset = parent path, datapoint = last part) and HDC-native datapoints all show up as Fields.<System>.<...> tags.

list.name: system
list.label: System
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(tag, '.', 2) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN datapoint = 'value' THEN asset WHEN position('.' in datapoint) > 0 THEN datapoint ELSE asset || '.' || datapoint END AS tag FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")) r ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(tag, '.', 2) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN datapoint = 'value' THEN asset WHEN position('.' in datapoint) > 0 THEN datapoint ELSE asset || '.' || datapoint END AS tag FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")) r ORDER BY 1

list.name: tag
list.label: Tags
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN datapoint = 'value' THEN asset WHEN position('.' in datapoint) > 0 THEN datapoint ELSE asset || '.' || datapoint END AS tag FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")) r WHERE split_part(tag, '.', 2) IN (${system:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN datapoint = 'value' THEN asset WHEN position('.' in datapoint) > 0 THEN datapoint ELSE asset || '.' || datapoint END AS tag FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")) r WHERE split_part(tag, '.', 2) IN (${system:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last reading
panels.description: Age of the newest row in the readings table: shows whether DataLogger -> extractor -> HDC -> Timescale is still flowing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max("timestamp")) AS "Age" FROM ${table} WHERE "timestamp" > now() - interval '30 days'
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset || '/' || datapoint) AS "Tags", count(*) AS "Readings" FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval), count(*) AS "readings" FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), avg(value::double precision) AS "mean", min(value::double precision) AS "min", max(value::double precision) AS "max" FROM (SELECT "timestamp" AS ts, CASE WHEN datapoint = 'value' THEN asset WHEN position('.' in datapoint) > 0 THEN datapoint ELSE asset || '.' || datapoint END AS tag, value FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")) r WHERE tag = '${tag}' AND value ~ '^\s*[-+]?([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*|\.[0-9]+)([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?\s*$' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest value per tag
panels.description: Newest value of every tag in the selected systems within the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag) tag AS "Tag", value AS "Value", ts AS "Time", n AS "Readings in range" FROM (SELECT "timestamp" AS ts, CASE WHEN datapoint = 'value' THEN asset WHEN position('.' in datapoint) > 0 THEN datapoint ELSE asset || '.' || datapoint END AS tag, value, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY asset, datapoint) AS n FROM ${table} WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")) r WHERE split_part(tag, '.', 2) IN (${system:sqlstring}) ORDER BY tag, ts DESC
